depiction_rules.notes: D002 design derived from its supplied references: a dignified adult goddess with two arms, seated beside the Lord or listening among devotees. Other iconographic forms need their own scene directions.

visual_bible.face: serene adult face, compassionate almond-shaped eyes, small red bindi, gentle attentive expression
visual_bible.skin: warm golden-brown complexion rendered in painted mineral-pigment tones
visual_bible.hair: long dark hair, neatly arranged with restrained jasmine flowers
visual_bible.crown: proportionate gold crown, no peacock feather
visual_bible.clothing: deep red and maroon silk sari with gold border, muted green blouse
visual_bible.jewelry: traditional gold necklaces, earrings, armlets, bracelets and anklets; regal but restrained
visual_bible.symbol: pink lotus held naturally in one hand

never: no cropped crown, hands or feet
no readable text, signature or watermark
no extra arms unless a separately reviewed plan explicitly requires them
note: Dedicated Lakshmi character sheet approved by the user for D002 scenes; other iconographic forms require appropriate scene directions.
